summary: Independent plan review of build-delivery plan revision 4: no blocking findings. The exact plan and contract SHA256 values, nine registered document fingerprints, all six spec-index source bindings, user-approval evidence and target bindings, and the current 221-file source inventory digest match plan-review-input-r4.json and the contract. DSR-01 is resolved by explicitly preserving the established 120/180/240ms durations and 320-599/600-899/900px+ responsive ranges, with only easing left as an implementation choice. DSR-02 is resolved by requiring runtimeStateMap for runtime labels, visual state and actions, binding applied allow/deny labels to current matching receipts, and marking all five variant property/badge sample labels as static-preview-only; denial causes, expiry/cancellation, uncertain transport reconciliation and no automatic resend remain distinct. The 163-token/44-variant foundation and PRD scope are retained without scope inflation. The strengthened integrity validator is coherent on static inspection but was not executed. Plan, check contract and dependency holds remain coherent: fresh product/design reviews and handoffs precede consumers; real browser-triggered SDK mutations remain gated on bridge security, deny admission and recovery evidence; persistent user data remains held on storage/retention choices; synthetic, actual local-runtime and credential-dependent evidence stay separate; clean install, target inventory, uncached checks, operational drills and final independent product/code/UI/release reviews remain required. Recorded continuation authorization supports within-scope corrections and does not claim sentence-by-sentence user approval. This is a static entry-plan review, not implementation, test, runtime or UI completion. No contracted checks, tests, builds or probes were run, and no source or ledger was edited. Hashes and the requested gpt-6-astra/high route do not attest runtime model/effort identity. Passing this plan does not waive the remaining product/design handoffs or other implementation holds.
